result.rationale: In embeddable_hosts_controller.rb, update does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first; save_host(host)` and destroy calls `host.destroy` with no nil check, so a request for a nonexistent id raises NoMethodError on nil and returns a 500 instead of 404. Verifiable directly from the diff.

judged_text: update and destroy pass the fetched record straight to save_host/host.destroy without checking it exists. A PUT or DELETE against an already-deleted id — e.g. a second admin removing the same row from a stale tab — raises NoMethodError on nil and returns a 500 instead of a 404.
